item.title: Details Matter
item.description: A sovereign wealth fund paid $800 million for the Chrysler Building in 2008 and sold it a decade later for $150 million, largely because a punishing ground lease made the building structurally unprofitable for any owner. The buyers fared no better — one went bankrupt, the other defaulted on rent — and a New York court terminated their lease in 2024, leaving the building worth less than ever and the land owner, Cooper Union, back in control.
